_note: Chapter 17 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The university invited him to give a talk on academic honesty at the opening ceremony.
ex.cn: 学校请他在开学典礼上谈学术诚信。
ex.note: academic year 学年；academic performance 学业表现

ex.en: He acknowledged the risk but insisted that the evidence had to be shown.
ex.cn: 他承认风险存在，但坚持必须拿出证据。
ex.note: acknowledge doing 承认做过；acknowledge receipt of 确认收到

ex.en: They decided to advance the truth in small, solid steps rather than answer with a bigger story.
ex.cn: 他们决定用小而扎实的步子推进真相，而不是用更响亮的说法回应。
ex.note: advance the cause 推进事业；advance money 预付定金

ex.en: The book has been a steady advance in the study of local history.
ex.cn: 这部书一直是地方史研究上的稳步推进。
ex.note: an advance in … …方面的进展；in advance 事先

ex.en: She read the notice ahead of the meeting so that she would have time to ask questions.
ex.cn: 她在开会前就看了通知，好让自己有提问的时间。
ex.note: ahead of 在…之前；ahead of time 提前

ex.en: He always checked the source before he passed a story on to anyone else.
ex.cn: 他转述消息之前总会先查证来源。
ex.note: not always 未必总是；always 语气强于 usually

ex.en: The complaint was posted by an anonymous user, so nobody could answer it.
ex.cn: 这条投诉是由匿名用户发的，谁也回不了它。
ex.note: an anonymous source 匿名消息来源；anonymity n. 匿名

ex.en: His application was one of forty, but the committee selected only twelve candidates.
ex.cn: 他的申请是四十份中的一份，委员会却只挑出了十二个人。
ex.note: an application for … …的申请；application form 申请表

ex.en: The old building houses the department of art, and its studio smells of paint.
ex.cn: 那栋老楼里是艺术系，画室里满是油漆味。
ex.note: the art of … …的艺术；art school 艺术学校

ex.en: The athlete ran past without looking up, and the whole track seemed to belong to him.
ex.cn: 那位运动员跑过，头也不抬，整条跑道仿佛都属于他。

ex.en: A small crowd waited outside, awaiting the correction.
ex.cn: 外面等着的人不多，一小群而已，他们等着那份更正。
ex.note: await 等待（书面语，多用于通知、报道）

ex.en: The department held a spring barbecue on the lawn behind the engineering building.
ex.cn: 工程系在工学院后面的草坪上办了春季烧烤。
ex.note: have a barbecue 吃烧烤；barbecue 也可作动词：烤

ex.en: The professor stroked his gray beard while he listened to their story.
ex.cn: 教授听着他们的故事，一边捻着自己的灰白胡子。
ex.note: a full beard 满脸胡须；bearded adj. 长胡子的

ex.en: Bend the wire slowly so that it does not snap in the middle.
ex.cn: 慢慢把铁丝弯折，别让它从中间断掉。
ex.note: bend over backwards 竭尽全力；bend the rules 变通规则

ex.en: The path took a sharp bend around the old stone wall.
ex.cn: 小路在老石墙边拐了一个急弯。
ex.note: a bend in the road 路的转弯处

ex.en: He caught his leg on the blade of a broken fence.
ex.cn: 他的腿被破栅栏的铁片划了一下。
ex.note: a blade of grass 一根草；razor blade 刀片

ex.en: The first public report gave the small team a real boost.
ex.cn: 第一份公开报告给了这个小团队实实在在的一振。
ex.note: boost sales / confidence 提振销量/信心；a boost to 对…的推动

ex.en: He sat on the stairs with his head in his hands and could hardly breathe.
ex.cn: 他双手抱头坐在楼梯上，几乎喘不过气。
ex.note: breathe in / out 吸气/呼气；can't breathe 喘不过气

ex.en: The forum burst into a stream of angry notifications.
ex.cn: 论坛里爆出一连串愤怒的通知。
ex.note: burst into 突然出现；burst out 大声说出

ex.en: There was a short burst of laughter when the teacher made his joke.
ex.cn: 老师开了个玩笑，教室里爆发出一阵短促的笑声。
ex.note: a burst of 一阵（笑声、掌声）

ex.en: They launched a quiet campaign of small meetings, one dormitory at a time.
ex.cn: 他们发起了一场安静的运动：一场接一场的小型聚会，每次一个宿舍。
ex.note: an advertising campaign 广告宣传活动；campaign for 为…开展的活动

ex.en: Mark handed him a carton of juice and a cup of ice.
ex.cn: 马克递给他一盒果汁和一杯冰块。
ex.note: a carton of milk / juice 一盒牛奶/果汁

ex.en: At the opening ceremony of the spring term, David was asked to speak.
ex.cn: 春季学期开学典礼上，大卫被请去讲话。
ex.note: opening / graduation ceremony 开学/毕业典礼

ex.en: The air smelled of smoke and grilled cheese.
ex.cn: 空气里是烟和烤奶酪的味道。

ex.en: The old art building is circular, and there are no corners to hide in.
ex.cn: 那座老艺术楼是圆形的，没有一个可以藏人的角落。
ex.note: circular argument 循环论证；circular motion 圆周运动

ex.en: The post included a short clip of the screen and a screenshot of a contract.
ex.cn: 那则帖子里附了一段屏幕录像和一张合同截图。
ex.note: a video clip 一段小视频；paper clip 回形针

ex.en: Clip the pages together and hand them to the teacher.
ex.cn: 把这些页子夹在一起，交给老师。
ex.note: clip sth. with sth. 用…夹住某物

ex.en: The color of the button on the fake screen was slightly wrong.
ex.cn: 假屏幕上按钮的颜色略有偏差。
ex.note: in color 以彩色；color scheme 配色

ex.en: The sunset colored the whole bay orange.
ex.cn: 落日把整片海湾染成了橙色。
ex.note: colored by … 被…染上颜色

ex.en: Mark made a side-by-side comparison with the real app and found the fonts differed.
ex.cn: 马克把假应用和真应用并排比较，发现字体不同。
ex.note: in comparison with 与…相比；make a comparison 作比较

ex.en: They underlined every claim concerning the app so that each one could be tested.
ex.cn: 他们把每一条关于这个应用的断言都画了线，好让每一条都经得起检验。
ex.note: concerning = about 关于（正式书面语，多见于文件）

ex.en: One careless sentence could have worse consequences than the rumor itself.
ex.cn: 一句不谨慎的话，后果可能比谣言本身更糟。
ex.note: as a consequence of 由于；have consequences 带来后果

ex.en: The thread turned into a continuous stream of notifications for hours.
ex.cn: 那个帖子一连几个钟头都在源源不断地弹出通知。
ex.note: continuous 连续不断的；continuously 持续不断地

ex.en: A large corporation replied with a short statement and nothing more.
ex.cn: 那家大公司只回了一份简短的声明，此外什么也没说。
ex.note: a large / multinational corporation 大型/跨国公司

ex.en: "I was a coward," he said quietly, "and I wrote it to have someone to blame."
ex.cn: “我是个懦夫，”他低声说，“我写那帖子，就是想有个人可以被怪罪。”
ex.note: call sb. a coward 骂某人是懦夫；cowardly adj. 怯懦的

ex.en: The ferry cruised across a flat gray sea while a flock of gulls followed the boat.
ex.cn: 渡轮划过一片平坦的灰色海面，一群海鸥跟在船后。
ex.note: cruise along 沿…航行；go on a cruise 乘船游览

ex.en: A single post did more damage than the team had ever imagined.
ex.cn: 一则帖子造成的破坏，超出了团队的所有想象。
ex.note: do damage to 对…造成损害；damage control 损害控制

ex.en: David did not enjoy seeing him so small, but he wanted a decent ending.
ex.cn: 大卫并不想看他这副落魄样子，但他想要一个体面的收场。
ex.note: a decent job 一份体面的工作；decent enough 还算不错

ex.en: On Friday he delivered the correction himself and admitted every fact.
ex.cn: 星期五他亲自做出了更正，把每一条事实都承认了下来。
ex.note: deliver a speech 发表演讲；deliver a baby 接生

ex.en: Despite the severe pressure, the team refused to post anything before it had the facts.
ex.cn: 尽管压力巨大，团队仍拒绝在事实查清之前发布任何内容。
ex.note: despite + 名词/代词/动名词，相当于 although

ex.en: The fonts in the two screenshots differed in an obvious way.
ex.cn: 两张截图里的字体有着明显的差别。
ex.note: differ from 与…不同；differ in 在…方面有差异

ex.en: The exercise trained their logic and their discipline at the same time.
ex.cn: 这个练习同时训练了他们的逻辑和条理。
ex.note: keep / maintain discipline 维持纪律；a discipline 一个学科

ex.en: The headmaster disciplined the boys who had copied the exam.
ex.cn: 校长处分了那几个抄考卷的学生。
ex.note: discipline sb. for sth. 因某事处分某人

ex.en: Past a ditch and a low hedge, a circular hall came into view.
ex.cn: 过了沟渠和一道矮树篱，一栋圆形的楼出现在眼前。
ex.note: dig a ditch 挖沟；in the ditch 陷入困境

ex.en: Anyone could download the app in a minute, the anonymous post said.
ex.cn: 那则匿名帖子说，任何人一分钟之内就能把这个应用下载下来。
ex.note: download sth. 下载；download speed 下载速度

ex.en: Due to the rumor, thirty users decided to close their accounts by the next morning.
ex.cn: 受这条谣言影响，三十名用户决定第二天一早就注销账号。
ex.note: due to 由于；be due to do 该做（某事）；in due time 适时

ex.en: Their methods were economical: small meetings, honest answers, no expensive advertising.
ex.cn: 他们的办法很省：小小的聚会、诚实的回答，没有昂贵的广告。
ex.note: be economical with money 花钱节省；economical use 节约使用

ex.en: The studio smelled of paint, timber and warm electricity.
ex.cn: 画室里闻得到油漆和木料的气味，还有温热的电的味道。
ex.note: run on electricity 用电；electricity supply 供电

ex.en: They enabled two-step verification so that no one could log in without a code.
ex.cn: 他们开启了两步验证，这样没有验证码谁也登不进去。
ex.note: enable sb. to do 使某人能够做；enable access to 便于访问

ex.en: The original entry was replaced with a warning, and nothing was left out.
ex.cn: 原来那条帖子被换成了一则警示声明，一个事实也没有漏掉。
ex.note: an entry in a diary 日记里的一页；entry form 入境表

ex.en: Everybody in the team had always known that trust was their only real asset.
ex.cn: 团队里的每个人都一直清楚，信任是他们唯一真正的资产。
ex.note: everybody = everyone，但语气更口语化

ex.en: Planning a correction is one thing; executing it is quite another.
ex.cn: 计划一次更正是一回事，把它执行到位是另一回事。
ex.note: execute a plan 执行计划；be executed 被处决

ex.en: Only later did they learn the extent of the damage.
ex.cn: 他们直到后来才看清这场破坏的严重程度。
ex.note: to some extent 在某种程度上；the extent of … …的程度/范围

ex.en: The little island is famous for its rabbits and its single road.
ex.cn: 那座小岛以它的野兔和那条独路闻名。
ex.note: be famous for 以…闻名；be famous as 作为…而闻名

ex.en: A flock of gulls followed the boat, their feathers bright in the wind.
ex.cn: 一群海鸥跟在船后，羽毛在风里发亮。
ex.note: a feather in one's cap 值得骄傲的事

ex.en: The app now filters out anonymous posts that contain the word "scam".
ex.cn: 现在这个应用会把含有“scam”一词的匿名帖子过滤掉。
ex.note: filter out 过滤掉；filter through 渗透过

ex.en: A simple filter on the mail box stopped the junk letters.
ex.cn: 邮箱上一个简单的过滤器把那些垃圾邮件挡在了外面。
ex.note: filter into 渗入；a water filter 滤水器

ex.en: A flock of gulls followed the ferry across the gray sea.
ex.cn: 一群海鸥跟着渡轮飞过灰色的海面。
ex.note: a flock of birds / sheep 一群鸟/羊；flock to 涌向

ex.en: A foreigner with a camera asked them for directions.
ex.cn: 一个拿着相机的外国人向他们问路。
ex.note: a foreigner to … 对…而言的外人

ex.en: Anyone who came to the meeting was free to ask questions.
ex.cn: 凡是到场的人都可以自由提问。
ex.note: free of charge 免费；be free to do 可以随意做

ex.en: The manager spent three years working to free the small company from debt.
ex.cn: 经理花了三年时间，努力让这家公司摆脱债务。
ex.note: free sb. from sth. 使某人摆脱某事

ex.en: The island was famous for rabbits with soft fur that ignored tourists.
ex.cn: 这座岛以那些毛皮柔软、对游客毫不理会的兔子闻名。
ex.note: a coat made of fur 皮草外套

ex.en: The professor was a generous man who spoke in a slow, careful manner.
ex.cn: 教授是个宽厚的人，说话不紧不慢。
ex.note: be generous with 用…很大方；a generous offer 慷慨的提议

ex.en: "Oh god," she said, "you wrecked a month of work with one click."
ex.cn: “天哪，”她说，“你一键就毁掉了我们一个月的成果。”
ex.note: God 上帝（首字母大写）；thank God 感谢上帝

ex.en: He could not grasp how a single post had done so much damage.
ex.cn: 他无法理解一则帖子怎么能造成这么大的破坏。
ex.note: grasp the meaning of 理解…的含义

ex.en: They had a firm grasp of the facts before they spoke in public.
ex.cn: 在公开表态之前，他们已经牢牢掌握了事实。
ex.note: within one's grasp 触手可及；take hold of 抓住

ex.en: He looked guilty, and he did not deny it.
ex.cn: 他看上去像是心虚，而且并没有否认。
ex.note: feel guilty about 对…感到内疚；be guilty of 犯有…罪

ex.en: His laptop had exactly the same hardware as the one on the desk upstairs.
ex.cn: 他的笔记本电脑和楼上那台的硬件配置完全一样。
ex.note: hardware and software 硬件与软件

ex.en: A low hedge marked the edge of the college garden.
ex.cn: 一道矮树篱标出了学院花园的边界。
ex.note: a hedge against 对…的防备措施；hedge bets 两边下注

ex.en: He came back from the ride with a dark bruise on his hip.
ex.cn: 骑马回来后，他胯上有一块发青的淤伤。
ex.note: on the hip 胯部；hip pocket 裤子口袋

ex.en: They hired a horse for an hour and rode along the beach.
ex.cn: 他们租了一小时的马，沿着海边骑。
ex.note: ride a horse 骑马；a horse of a different color 完全不同的事

ex.en: Mark handed him a carton of juice and a cup of ice.
ex.cn: 马克递给他一盒果汁和一杯冰块。
ex.note: ice cubes 冰块；on the ice 岌岌可危

ex.en: They implemented a clear privacy page within a single week.
ex.cn: 他们在一周之内就做出了一页清晰的隐私说明。
ex.note: implement a policy 实施政策；implement a plan 执行计划

ex.en: Every tool in the workshop is a simple implement of wood and iron.
ex.cn: 工坊里的每一样工具，都是木铁做成的简单器具。
ex.note: farm implements 农具；an implement of sth. 某种器具

ex.en: "You were indifferent to people like me," he said quietly.
ex.cn: “你们对像我这样的人漠不关心。”他低声说。
ex.note: be indifferent to 对…漠不关心；indifference n. 冷漠

ex.en: The data input page had no field for phone numbers at all.
ex.cn: 那个数据输入页上，根本就没有填电话号码的栏位。
ex.note: data input 数据输入；a useful input 有用的信息

ex.en: Users can input a name and a password, and nothing else.
ex.cn: 用户只需输入用户名和密码，别的什么都不用填。
ex.note: input data into a computer 把数据输入电脑

ex.en: In the small meetings, users could interact directly with the team.
ex.cn: 在这些小聚会上，用户可以直接和团队交流。
ex.note: interact with 与…互动；interaction n. 互动

ex.en: In April the team took a weekend trip to a small island.
ex.cn: 四月，团队利用周末去了一座小岛。
ex.note: an island country 岛国；a desert island 荒岛

ex.en: They drank cold juice with ice after the long walk.
ex.cn: 走完那段长路，他们喝的是加冰的凉果汁。
ex.note: orange juice 橙汁；the juice of life 生命之汁

ex.en: David kneeled down to read the sign at the foot of the tree.
ex.cn: 大卫跪下身，去读立在树脚下的那块牌子。
ex.note: kneel at sb.'s feet 跪在某人脚边；kneel down 跪下

ex.en: You can answer with a better story, or advance the truth in small steps; the latter is slower, but it lasts.
ex.cn: 你可以用一个更好的说法回应，也可以用小步子推进真相；后者慢一些，却更长久。
ex.note: the former / the latter 前者/后者

ex.en: A nurse cleaned the cut on his leg where he had caught it on a broken fence.
ex.cn: 一位护士清理了他腿上被破栅栏划出的伤口。
ex.note: a leg of the journey 旅程的一段；pull one's leg 逗弄某人

ex.en: A low limb of an old tree hung over the wreck.
ex.cn: 一棵老树的低枝悬在残骸上方。
ex.note: upper / lower limbs 四肢；artificial limb 假肢

ex.en: The exercise stimulated their logic and taught them to test every claim.
ex.cn: 这个练习激发了他们的逻辑，也教会他们检验每一条说法。
ex.note: common sense logic 常识性逻辑；logical adj. 合乎逻辑的

ex.en: He was mad with anger at first, and then simply tired.
ex.cn: 他先是气疯了，后来就只剩疲惫。
ex.note: be mad at 对…发火；mad about 热衷于

ex.en: March came in with wind and a rumor that changed everything.
ex.cn: 三月是伴着风和一条改变了一切的谣言到来的。
ex.note: in March 在三月；the March of Progress 进步的历史潮流

ex.en: Meanwhile, the bookstore went back to its usual routine.
ex.cn: 与此同时，书店恢复了往日的节奏。
ex.note: meanwhile = at the same time 同时

ex.en: The old hall stood twenty meters beyond the low hedge.
ex.cn: 那栋老楼在矮树篱再往前二十米的地方。
ex.note: meter 作“米”时美音读 /ˈmiːtər/；作“仪表”时读 /ˈmiːtər/，也可用英音 /ˈmiːtə(r)/

ex.en: No fact was missing from his apology.
ex.cn: 他的道歉没有漏掉任何一个事实。
ex.note: be missing from 缺少；go missing 失踪

ex.en: Most of the comments were confused rather than hostile.
ex.cn: 多数评论是困惑，而不是敌意。
ex.note: most of 大多数；the most … 最…

ex.en: "I wrote it myself," he said quietly, "and I have to say so."
ex.cn: “是我自己写的，”他低声说，“这一点我必须说出来。”
ex.note: by myself 独自；myself 作反身或强调代词

ex.en: "We neglected that," he said, "but it does not excuse this."
ex.cn: “我们忽略了这一点，”他说，“但这不能成为开脱的理由。”
ex.note: neglect to do 忘记做；neglect of duty 玩忽职守

ex.en: The professor nodded from the third row without saying a word, a quiet nod of agreement.
ex.cn: 教授在第三排一句话也没说地点了点头，表示赞同。
ex.note: nod one's head 点头；a nod of approval 赞许的点头；nod off 打瞌睡

ex.en: A nurse at the village clinic cleaned the cut on his leg.
ex.cn: 乡村诊所的一位护士清理了他腿上的伤口。
ex.note: a nurse for the baby 保姆；nurse station 护士站

ex.en: She nursed the feverish boy through the whole night.
ex.cn: 她照顾那个发着烧的男孩，照顾了整整一夜。
ex.note: nurse a cold 感冒时调养；nurse sb. back to health 护理某人恢复健康

ex.en: The professor offered them a second choice: advance the truth in small steps.
ex.cn: 教授给了他们第二个选择：用小步子推进真相。
ex.note: offer sb. sth. 给某人某物；offer to do 主动提出做

ex.en: They received a formal offer from the company in December.
ex.cn: 十二月份，他们收到了那家公司的正式录用通知。
ex.note: an offer of help 主动相助；accept an offer 接受提议

ex.en: "You have an option," the professor said, "and only one of them lasts."
ex.cn: “你们有一个选择，”教授说，“而只有一条路留得住。”
ex.note: a wide range of options 多种选择；have the option of 可以选择

ex.en: The locker points reported a steady output of trades every week.
ex.cn: 储物柜积分那边报告说，每周都有稳定的交易产出。
ex.note: output 产量；output of production 生产量

ex.en: The machine outputs one line of numbers every hour.
ex.cn: 这台机器每小时输出一行数字。
ex.note: output data 输出数据

ex.en: A painter worked at an easel near the window without looking up.
ex.cn: 一位画家在窗边的画架前作画，头也不抬。
ex.note: house painter 油漆工；landscape painter 风景画家

ex.en: They walked through a narrow passage between two old halls.
ex.cn: 他们穿过两栋老楼之间的一条窄道。
ex.note: a passage from a book 书中的段落；sea passage 海峡

ex.en: A student with a pencil was sketching a horse from a photograph.
ex.cn: 一个拿着铅笔的学生照着照片画一匹马。
ex.note: in pencil 用铅笔；pencil case 铅笔盒

ex.en: The difficult episode would be a phase in the story, not its end.
ex.cn: 这段难熬的日子会是故事里的一个阶段，而不是结局。
ex.note: a phase of … …的一个阶段；in phases 分阶段地

ex.en: The price of the second pitch rose too fast for most buyers.
ex.cn: 第二次报价涨得太快，多数买家都吃不消。
ex.note: a sales pitch 推销说辞；the pitch 球场

ex.en: A confident speaker can pitch an idea to a crowded room.
ex.cn: 有自信的演说者能把自己的想法推销给满屋子的听众。
ex.note: pitch in 投入；pitch in 帮工

ex.en: A painted sign warned that a poisonous plant grew nearby.
ex.cn: 一块漆过的牌子警告说，附近长着有毒的植物。
ex.note: poisonous gas / plants 有毒气体/植物；poisonous language 恶毒的语言

ex.en: He possessed a laptop with exactly the same hardware as the others.
ex.cn: 他有一台硬件配置与别人完全相同的笔记本电脑。
ex.note: be possessed of 拥有；possess sb. 使某人着魔

ex.en: Their preference was for explanation rather than argument.
ex.cn: 他们宁可解释，也不愿争辩。
ex.note: a preference for 对…的偏爱；in preference to 而不是

ex.en: The server logs showed no prior connection to any foreign address.
ex.cn: 服务器日志显示，此前从未与任何境外地址建立过连接。
ex.note: prior to 在…之前（= before）；without prior notice 事先没有通知

ex.en: The fake screen used a pronoun where the real one used a noun.
ex.cn: 假屏幕上用的是代词，而真正的界面上用的是名词。
ex.note: personal / relative pronoun 人称/关系代词

ex.en: A water pump stood beside the path, its handle worn smooth.
ex.cn: 路旁立着一台水泵，摇柄被磨得光滑。
ex.note: a petrol pump 加油机；pump up 给…打气

ex.en: She pumped water from the well into a bucket.
ex.cn: 她把井里的水抽上来，倒进一只桶里。
ex.note: pump water 抽水；heart pump 心脏泵

ex.en: A population of rabbits with soft fur lived on the quiet island.
ex.cn: 那座安静的小岛上生活着一群毛皮柔软的兔子。
ex.note: the rabbit race 龟兔赛跑；like a rabbit 像兔子一样

ex.en: Their own blog entry reached more readers than the rumor had.
ex.cn: 他们自己那篇博客，读到的人比那条谣言还多。
ex.note: a reader of Chinese literature 汉语文学读者；readers' comments 读者评论

ex.en: They recycled every carton and bottle before they left the island.
ex.cn: 离开小岛之前，他们把每一个纸盒和瓶子都回收了。
ex.note: recycle paper 回收废纸；recyclable adj. 可回收的

ex.en: It was relatively little compared with a big company's advertising budget.
ex.cn: 和一家大公司的广告预算相比，这点投入算不了多少。
ex.note: relatively speaking 相对而言；relatively few 相对较少

ex.en: A student representative from each dorm was invited to review the policy.
ex.cn: 每栋宿舍都派了一名学生代表来审阅这份政策。
ex.note: a representative of sb. 某人的代表；销售代表

ex.en: Her argument was a representative example of what they meant by fairness.
ex.cn: 她的论点正是他们所说的公平的一个典型例子。
ex.note: be representative of 有代表性的

ex.en: The team spent weeks trying to restore what one post had taken away.
ex.cn: 团队花了几个星期，想把一则帖子夺走的东西一点点修复回来。
ex.note: restore order 恢复秩序；restore sb. to health 使某人恢复健康

ex.en: We have to acknowledge the risk, but we also have to show the evidence.
ex.cn: 我们得承认风险存在，但同时也必须拿出证据。
ex.note: at the risk of 冒着…的风险；run risks 冒险

ex.en: He risked his own job to tell the truth about the app.
ex.cn: 他冒着丢掉工作的风险，说出了关于这个应用的真相。
ex.note: risk doing sth. 冒险做某事

ex.en: A few of the comments were rude, but most were simply worried.
ex.cn: 有几条评论很不客气，但大多数只是担心。
ex.note: be rude to sb. 对某人无礼；it is rude to do 干…很没礼貌

ex.en: David felt no satisfaction in seeing his rival so small.
ex.cn: 看到对手这副落魄样子，大卫并没有感到痛快。
ex.note: with satisfaction 满意地；to one's satisfaction 令人满意的是

ex.en: A pair of scissors lay on the table beside him.
ex.cn: 他身旁的桌上放着一把剪刀。
ex.note: a pair of scissors 一把剪刀；scissors 作复数用

ex.en: The committee selected twelve students from forty applications.
ex.cn: 委员会从四十份申请中选出了十二名学生。
ex.note: select from 从…中挑选；be selected for 被选入

ex.en: The shop sells a small select group of hand-made tools.
ex.cn: 这家店只卖少量精选的手工工具。
ex.note: a select few 少数精选的；selection n. 选集

ex.en: Despite the severe pressure, they refused to say anything that was not true.
ex.cn: 尽管压力巨大，他们仍拒绝说一句不实的话。
ex.note: severe weather 恶劣天气；severe penalty 严厉处罚

ex.en: The team was still short of money, and there would be other storms.
ex.cn: 团队仍旧缺钱，而后面还会有别的风暴。
ex.note: be short of 缺少；short of money 缺钱

ex.en: He stopped short of accusing anyone by name.
ex.cn: 他差点就点出某个人的名字，却忍住了。
ex.note: stop short of 险些；run short of 快要用完

ex.en: Similarly, the volunteers who had stayed became more careful and more loyal.
ex.cn: 同样，留下来的志愿者变得更谨慎，也更忠诚。
ex.note: similarly to 与…相似地；and similarly 同样地

ex.en: He admitted that he had been a slave to envy for years.
ex.cn: 他承认自己多年来一直是嫉妒的奴仆。
ex.note: a slave to 对…的奴隶；slave labor 奴隶劳动

ex.en: A society is held together by small acts of accuracy.
ex.cn: 一个社会是靠许多微小的求真之举维系的。
ex.note: modern society 现代社会；the society of … …的社会

ex.en: The soul of a university is the habit of checking before you believe.
ex.cn: 一所大学的灵魂，在于相信之前先查证的习惯。
ex.note: the soul of … …的灵魂；heart and soul 全心全意

ex.en: The team chose to spend weeks repairing what one post had taken.
ex.cn: 团队宁愿花上几个星期，去修复一则帖子夺走的东西。
ex.note: spend time / money on 在…上花费时间/金钱

ex.en: He sat on the staircase with his head in his hands and could hardly breathe.
ex.cn: 他双手抱头坐在楼梯上，几乎喘不过气。
ex.note: on the staircase 在楼梯上；a spiral staircase 螺旋楼梯

ex.en: Writing down every claim stimulated their logic and their discipline.
ex.cn: 把每一条断言都写下来，激发了他们的逻辑，也磨出了他们的条理。
ex.note: stimulate growth 刺激增长；stimulate sb. to do 促使某人做

ex.en: The workers decided to strike for higher pay.
ex.cn: 工人们决定罢工，要求更高的工资。
ex.note: strike for / against 为…而罢工；strike sb. as 使某人觉得…

ex.en: The strike lasted three days and ended without a clear result.
ex.cn: 这次罢工持续了三天，最后没有明确结果。
ex.note: a general strike 总罢工；be on strike 在罢工

ex.en: The small company suffered for three weeks, and the loss was hard to measure.
ex.cn: 这家公司整整三个星期没好过，损失也很难估量。
ex.note: suffer from 遭受；suffer a loss 遭受损失

ex.en: The team had learned the supreme lesson of the year.
ex.cn: 团队学到了这一年最重要的一课。
ex.note: the supreme court 最高法院；supreme happiness 无上的幸福

ex.en: Sarah said nothing, but her sympathy was more useful than advice.
ex.cn: 萨拉什么也没说，可她的同情比建议更有用。
ex.note: show sympathy for 对…表示同情；in sympathy with 同情

ex.en: A simple technique made the difference between the two apps obvious.
ex.cn: 一个简单的技巧，让这两个应用之间的差别变得一目了然。
ex.note: teaching technique 教学技巧；a useful technique 有用的技巧

ex.en: The truth is slower than a lie, but it lasts longer.
ex.cn: 真相比谎言走得慢，却比谎言走得更远。
ex.note: more than / less than 比…多/少；rather than 而不是

ex.en: Within an hour the thread had thirteen replies.
ex.cn: 一小时内，这个帖子就有了十三条回复。
ex.note: 基数词，放在名词前；thirteen hundred 一千三百

ex.en: The studio smelled of paint, timber and warm electricity.
ex.cn: 画室里闻得到油漆和木料的气味，还有温热的电的味道。
ex.note: timber 木料；the timber trade 木材业

ex.en: The topic stayed at the top of the forum for two whole days.
ex.cn: 这个话题在论坛顶端整整挂了两天。
ex.note: on the topic of 关于；a sensitive topic 敏感话题

ex.en: Public transportation was almost nonexistent, so they walked everywhere.
ex.cn: 岛上几乎没有公共交通，所以他们到处都靠步行。
ex.note: public transportation 公共交通；transportation costs 运输费用

ex.en: Trust does not travel at the speed of a click; it moves at the speed of a conversation.
ex.cn: 信任不会以点击的速度传播；它以一种对话的速度前行。
ex.note: trust in 对…的信任；trust sb. with sth. 把某事托付给某人

ex.en: He asked them to underline every claim concerning the app and mark the ones that could be tested.
ex.cn: 他让他们把每一条关于这个应用的断言都画上横线，并标出哪些经得起检验。
ex.note: underline the importance of 强调…的重要性；underlined 划了线的

ex.en: David read the post twice in the office upstairs and felt the floor move under him.
ex.cn: 大卫在楼上的办公室里把帖子读了两遍，只觉得地板在脚下晃动。
ex.note: go upstairs 上楼；the upstairs room 楼上的房间

ex.en: He watched the runner with a variety of feelings, most of them envy.
ex.cn: 他望着那名赛艇运动员，心里五味杂陈，多半是嫉妒。
ex.note: a variety of 各种各样的；a wide variety of 多种多样的

ex.en: He did not give a speech about virtue in the abstract.
ex.cn: 他没有讲一套抽象的美德。
ex.note: a virtue 优点；the virtue of … …的优点

ex.en: "What do you want?" David asked him.
ex.cn: “你想要什么？”大卫问他。
ex.note: want sth. 想要；want for sth. 缺少

ex.en: David walked there on a weekday afternoon, when the halls were quiet.
ex.cn: 一个工作日的下午，大卫走到那里，那会儿楼里很安静。
ex.note: on weekdays 在工作日；a busy weekday 忙碌的工作日

ex.en: He stood at the front of the hall in a white shirt.
ex.cn: 他穿着白衬衫站在礼堂前方。
ex.note: white lie 善意的谎言；in black and white 白纸黑字

ex.en: Thirty users decided to withdraw their accounts by the next morning.
ex.cn: 三十名用户决定第二天一早就注销账号。
ex.note: withdraw money 取款；withdraw from 从…退出/撤回

ex.en: They found the wreck of an old fishing boat half buried in the grass.
ex.cn: 他们发现了那艘旧渔船的残骸，半埋在草丛里。
ex.note: a shipwreck 海难；the wreck of … …的残骸

ex.en: One careless sentence could wreck everything the team had built.
ex.cn: 一句不谨慎的话，就可能毁掉团队辛苦建立的一切。
ex.note: wreck a plan 破坏计划；wrecked adj. 毁坏了的
